product: automatic chicken feeder and cup waterer

slides.t: Hens scratch and flick feed out of open trays. Spilled feed draws rats and sparrows and goes moldy.
A hopper feeds into ports or a lipped tray, so less feed is raked out. Hens eat from it as they need.
Small cups refill from a closed tank, so water stays cleaner than in an open dish full of litter.
Capacity for your flock, easy filling and cleaning, and a lid that keeps rain and pests out.
Hanging it too low or too high, never cleaning the cups, and not checking hens learned to use it.

hook: A gift for the gardener who has everything

slides.t: Packets of kitchen herbs like basil, parsley, chives, dill and thyme. Enough to start a whole windowsill.
Herbs grow fine indoors in a bright window, so a gardener can sow something fresh in the cold months.
Sow shallow in moist seed mix, keep warm and lightly damp. Most herbs sprout in one to three weeks.
Give a south window or a grow light. Weak light makes tall, floppy seedlings with little flavor.
Burying tiny seeds too deep, overwatering, and cutting too much at once. Take a third, let it regrow.
